topic: JCD Brazil sensor traffic monitoring issue
summary_markdown: A query was raised regarding a significant drop (approximately 100 sensors) in the 'traffic' category for JCD Brazil over the past week, based on monitoring data. Suggestions included potential system updates as a cause. Participants requested assistance to investigate the issue and determine how to verify the sensor count.
action_items: Investigate the reported drop of 100 sensors in JCD Brazil traffic category.
